title: Stans Hardcore Modpack
description: All the mods Stan616 uses on his hardcore series!
body:
# NVIDIA VERSION IS X.X.0. NON-NVIDIA VERSION IS 1.0.1

Stans Hardcore Modpack is a modpack that conatains all of Stan616s mods that are used on his Hardcore Survival World! This pack will be updated to whenever Stan616 updates his list of Mods!

This pack features: 
Building Mods: Axiom and WorldEdit
Optimisation Mods: Sodium, Nvidium* and Lithium
Quality Of Life Mods: WiZoom, Better Clouds and Simple Fog Control
And So Much More!

*Not Included in the non-nvidia GPU modpack

Any Issues? Contact me on discord: Panex1_

Please dont contact Stan616 or any of his amazing staff about this modpack. Since they are not on the server to provide mod support
